products.title: Siux Stallion 12k 2026 - Siux
products.description:
SIUX STALLION 12K 2026 - An incredibly powerful racket, for lovers of the diamond format and the best carbon fiber, the 12K. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The new SIUX STALLION 12K 2026 is a racket meticulously designed to offer the best sensations in the attack zone. Clearly due to its diamond format, we classify it as a power racket.

PLAYER TYPE

It is an excellent alternative within the range of Siux 2026 rackets for intermediate/advanced level players looking for a powerful, stable racket with a modern aesthetic.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The SIUX STALLION 12K 2026 shares the same diamond format as the successful Spyder series, offering attack-oriented balance and excellent power in spikes, volleys and overhead shots.

Getting to know it more in depth, it is a racket made entirely of 12K carbon fiber. This material provides a firm touch, great resistance and a very precise response in each impact.

The chosen rubber that it incorporates is an EVA Core, which provides a perfect balance between power, comfort and ball output.

In addition, it integrates Optimus Holes technology, a perforation pattern designed to expand the sweet spot, improve stability and optimize the distribution of forces in each hit.

products.title: Head Revolt Pro 5.0 Men Blueberry Teal - Head
products.description:
HEAD REVOLT PRO 5.0 MEN BLUEBERRY TEAL - Head Padel presents its new collection of footwear, with new designs and technologies. Never before has this Revolt Pro model been so comfortable. Designed to last a long time. The HEAD REVOLT PRO 5.0 MEN BLUEBERRY TEAL represent a clear evolution within the high-performance range. They are designed for high-performance players since, due to their characteristics and benefits, they are the best option to get 100% out of it.

Advanced structural stability
They incorporate three 3D molded pieces of TPU strategically located in the midsole and upper part. It highlights CORE-CONTROL technology, a TPU chassis that stabilizes the foot from the medial area to the front lateral part.

In addition, this model integrates a new cooling system, which greatly improves both ventilation and stability.

Intelligent triple EVA cushioning
The midsole combines three compounds to optimize performance and comfort:

DynaFoam in the heel: excellent shock absorption.

Reactive EVA in the forefoot: greater impulse and response.

Softer area in the midfoot and big toe: additional comfort during prolonged support.

products.title: Paletero Vibora Technic Negro Rojo - Vibora
products.description:

The VIBORA TECHNIC BLACK RED PADEL RACKET BAG has been developed for male and female players who are looking for more than just functionality: they want style, organization and resistance on and off the court.

Inside, you will find everything you need to carry your equipment with order and comfort:

A large and ventilated main compartment, perfect for clothing or sports accessories. In addition, it includes two interior pockets for personal items, one with a zipper and the other open, and a space with an elastic band for used clothing.

Toiletry bag removable with clasps, ideal for carrying hygiene items or small accessories.

Independent and ventilated shoe rack that keeps your shoes separate from the rest of the contents.

Thermal side compartment that protects your padel racket against changes in temperature, preserving its materials and shape.

Two additional zippered side pockets, ideal for storing accessories or personal effects.

For easy transportation, it includes a top hand handle and padded backpack-style straps, which ensure comfort while traveling. In addition, the base incorporates four support studs that protect the bottom of the padel racket from direct contact with the ground, extending its useful life.
